description: config/ is QIDI's stock Max 4 config. scripts/check_stock_config.py compares it with `stock`: comments, whitespace, and blank lines may differ; `translated_strings` lists each message string translated from QIDI's Chinese (stock line, config/ line); `added_lines` is the include wiring Valve Oil needs; `unchanged` files are read-only on the printer and pinned by SHA-256; `printer_written` files are written by QIDI's software on each printer, so only scripts/check_identifiers.py reads them.
